scope: All production TypeScript source under packages/*/src, apps/action/src, apps/self-release/src. Tooling and tests reviewed separately in report; generated dist, research/prototypes/vendor excluded.
method: TypeScript 6.0.3 AST inventory. Counts identify review candidates, not confirmed defects. Every occurrence names its source-owner module. Nested assertions and catches are distinct AST nodes. No nonliteral template requires appear in static graph. Nested AST expressions at the same start coordinate receive a deterministic nested ordinal.

runtimeCycleMethodCorrection: The historical method above excluded inline type-only named specifiers. With verbatimModuleSyntax, import { type T } from "module" emits an empty runtime import in TypeScript 6 and 7. Only declaration-level import type/export type is erased; inline specifier-only declarations remain runtime edges. The retained empty-cycle result is not complete runtime-cycle proof. Current qualification belongs to the implementation import gate and implementation-status.md.
